scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from playwright; status=$?; docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v --remove-orphans; exit $status
scripts.test:e2e:logs: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.e2e.yml logs --no-color app-auth-on app-noauth-1 app-noauth-2 playwright
